extraction.teacher_style: The instructor breaks down salsa pachanga footwork thoroughly with clear verbal explanations and repeated demonstrations facing the mirror. He systematically details upper and lower body mechanics, weight shifts, and common pitfalls.

lesson_structure.note: Demonstrates the pachanga basic footwork in front of a mirror.
Introduces himself and the lesson on basic pachanga steps.
Breaks down upper body movement and posture.
Explains the counting scheme and preparation phase.
Explains weight shifting from right to left.
Details footwork mechanics and opening knees.

cues: and one and three and five and seven
metaphors: imagine you are like a doll and it's a plastic doll
common_mistakes: doing squats instead of small forward and back movements
bringing upper body too much back

steps_taught.name: Pachanga Basic Step
steps_taught.description: Basic pachanga footwork with forward and back torso action and weight shifts.

what_works: Clear mirror angle showing both front and back view in reflection
Detailed breakdown of upper and lower body coordination
what_hinders: Long verbal explanations before full speed practice
